dimensions.assessment: Affects domestic and international travelers, music tourism venues, and federal tourism officials.
dimensions.evidence: promote domestic and international travel and tourism to U.S. music festivals, concert venues, and other music-related attractions and locations.

dimensions.assessment: Administrative and promotional change rather than a mandate altering legal rights or financial benefits.
dimensions.evidence: directs the National Travel and Tourism Office (NTTO) of the Department of Commerce to promote tourism to music-related and sports attractions.

dimensions.assessment: No explicit appropriations or federal funding levels are specified in the source text.
Amends existing statutory duties under the Visit America Act and adds periodic reporting requirements to congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: This Act may be cited as the American Music Tourism Act of 2025

dimensions.assessment: Mandates ongoing reports every two years following an initial one-year report.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of the American Music Tourism Act of 2025, and every 2 years thereafter

missing_information: Any allocation of funds or specific budgetary impacts for promotional activities.
importance_detail.rationale: Expands the responsibilities of the National Travel and Tourism Office to promote music tourism and sports attractions, requiring regular reports to Congress.
